name: yuan1z0825/nature-skills
description: A collection of bilingual Chinese-English skills for academic paper work, including paper reading and data extraction for paper readers. A router skill directs the agent to the right sub-skill, and the nature-data skill extracts structured data from papers.
install: npx skills add Yuan1z0825/nature-skills --list, or per skill npx skills add Yuan1z0825/nature-skills --agent codex --skill nature-figure --yes --copy
